content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication. The patient presents with recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the patient's personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the indication note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management. The claim was denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was not obtained."}
